title: Basketball bracketology
items: The Bracket tab for college basketball now shows a projected 68-team NCAA tournament field: the bracket by region, the bubble, the seed list, conference bids and tournament odds, with a résumé card for every Division I team.
It is an early projection, marked Beta, from 10,000 simulated seasons on the preseason ratings and the full 2026-27 schedule. It refreshes every week and moves to real results as games are played.
